ios.desc:
"BREAK FREE FROM GRAVITY AND REACH LIMITLESS SKIES!
450+ OFFICIAL SPEED VEHICLES: From the iconic Ferrari, Ducati, and Lamborghini to the powerful McLaren, Bugatti, and Mercedes, as well as popular brands like Audi, Ford, and Chevrolet, our game offers a wide range of bikes and cars to choose from!
PERSONALIZE YOUR RACER AVATAR: Create a unique Racer Avatar and express your individual style with a vast selection of clothing, costumes, and accessories. Discover a variety of options and mix-and-match to your heart's content!
CROSS-SAVE & CROSS-PLAY: Begin your exhilarating races on macOS and seamlessly continue the action on your iOS device. Enjoy the flexibility of playing across different platforms!
INTENSE ARCADE GAMEPLAY: Experience the adrenaline rush of gravity-defying racing on more than 50 thrilling high-speed tracks!
UNLOCK EXCLUSIVE REWARDS: Compete in Time-Limited Events for incredible prizes! Enhance your racing experience with special events and gain access to exclusive content and bonuses through Racing Passes!
HIGH-OCTANE MULTIPLAYER ACTION: Engage in real-time multiplayer races with up to 12 opponents. Challenge your friends to ghost races and showcase your skills!
CUSTOMIZE & UPGRADE YOUR VEHICLES: Showcase your style and dominance on the track with over 2,300 decals. Take down your opponents with flair!
UNPARALLELED CONTENT VARIETY: Immerse yourself in the game with over 400 Career events, 1,500 Car Mastery challenges, six unique game modes, and a vast collection of cars. The single-player content is virtually endless!

470 MILLION PLAYERS CAN’T BE WRONG!
TAKE A SPIN WITH THE FRONTRUNNER AMONG RACING GAMES!

ACCLAIMED BY PLAYERS & THE PRESS!
WINNER: **MWC Best Mobile Game App**
WINNER: **Pocket Gamer Best Sports/Racing Game Award**
